card.name: Linking words in sterility and particulate lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, from, non, for, of, commas) in lists of purity or quality checks. They come after terms like sterility, sterile, microbial or particulate matter, just before the next item such as mycoplasma, discoloration or pyrogenic.

modes.label: And between quality checks
modes.description: The word 'and' or a comma joins sterility, particulate or microbial terms to the next contaminant or test.

modes.description: The word 'non' after 'sterile' leads into a hyphenated word such as non-pyrogenic or non-toxic.

modes.label: Free from or lack of
modes.description: A preposition after 'free' or 'lack' leads into visible particles or preservatives.
